description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the list of Designated Person under Regulation 4(7) of the United Nations Regulation No. 1 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulation No. 1 of 2012, which is a legal/regulatory action. It involves modifying a statutory instrument (the list of designated entities and individuals) under the authority of the United Nations Act, No. 45 of 1968. The content focuses on legal designations and regulatory compliance matters related to counter-terrorism, not government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
